No 1  3 PM 
Caldwell Richmond  Wash. May 18. 1865
Govern Imogene for Meriden unity no plug swells pelton
polkaers know the officers under them who by their
services and qualifications are fit forth regular oyster The
object is to get officers who have <insertion>proven themselves</insertion> qualified by
their conduct in actual war Pelham & other independent 
polkaers order the boards yoke Juno


AH Caldwell Richmond  No 2  Wash 7 PM May 18 / 65
Minnie Mason for Empress Tulip Spark wait sell is
directed torry deuce his wagons allen half and the
mules he takes Austin fourths with the expectation of
gathering in Belgium the addition all animals he may
want tulip I think the reduction of animals might
be still greater Allie will want at first wilby
mules enough to secure about Andrew good teams to
Allen Sprague summed yacht The white summer connected with
panamas may be quickened & sent here for muster
outer detained few have use forum Stick Allen Sharon
to Allen Donelson summer wilby sufficient for white sell
toothache with him wind Magic
